answer_1.quote: automatic impression generation (AIG) has drawn substantial attention in recent years... We follow the standard sequence-to-sequence paradigm for AIG.

answer_2.quote: we report F1 scores of ROUGE-1 (R-1), ROUGE-2 (R-2), and ROUGE-L (R-L). Besides, for FC metrics, we utilize CheXbert to detect 14 observations related to diseases from reference impressions and generated impressions and then calculate the precision, recall, and F1 score between these two identified results.

answer_4.quote: We invite three medical experts to score these generated impressions based on these four metrics: Key, Readability, Accuracy, and Completeness, respectively.
answer_4.guideline: Experts scored generated impressions using four metrics: Key, Readability, Accuracy, and Completeness.
